data.title: About the Department
description: The Department of Master of Computer Applications (MCA), established in 2001 with an initial intake of 40 students, offers a two-year full-time postgraduate programme. The curriculum is carefully designed to meet evolving industry requirements and includes a comprehensive blend of core subjects, specialization courses, mini projects, employability-focused training, and application-oriented learning. The syllabus is regularly updated to incorporate the latest advancements in technology. In addition, the Computer Applications Association actively organizes industrial seminars, workshops, and guest lectures to enrich students’ academic experience. Soft skills and programming training are also integral components of the programme.

content: Students are consistently encouraged to engage in self-directed learning through mini projects, student seminars, and major project work. The department houses a well-equipped library with over 10,000 volumes, including books, magazines, back issues, project reports, CDs/DVDs, daily newspapers, previous years’ question papers (since 2001), and both national and international journals. To further enhance subject knowledge, the library provides access to NPTEL video resources through online platforms.

The department is supported by a highly qualified, dedicated, and service-oriented faculty team. Faculty members provide continuous guidance to students, particularly in addressing software-related challenges. They possess expertise in areas such as Cloud Computing, Data Analytics, Neural Networks, Python Programming, Blockchain Technologies, and Image Processing, and hold certifications from IBM, Infosys Springboard and NPTEL.

The department actively promotes student participation in curricular, co-curricular, extracurricular, and sports activities. Faculty and students collaboratively contribute to the development of software applications that support various institutional needs. Faculty members are also life members of ISTE and members of other professional societies like IEEE, IEANG, etc., reflecting their commitment to professional development.

To support academic and research activities, the department is equipped with two modern laboratories featuring the latest software, along with Wi-Fi connectivity and uninterrupted power supply (UPS), ensuring a conducive learning environment for both students and faculty.

content.title: Our Vision
content.description: To be a nationally prominent and recognized department in academics and research activities with the aim of developing competent professionals to serve the society in the ever changing industry.

item: Enabling the students to be knowledgeable and creative by developing state of the art curriculum and innovative teaching methods.
Producing highly competent professionals by providing training programs to bridge the gap between the institution and industry.
Enhancing the quality of research and productivity by providing the required facilities.

content.description: Graduates will be competent enough to identify, analyze, design and develop software solutions to the problems in the field.
Graduates, equipped with good communication skills and technical expertise will be able to conceptualize and lead projects with an aim to become effective entrepreneurs or employees.
Graduates, with exposure to highly active research environment, will have the motivation to participate and contribute in research and development.

content.title: Computational Knowledge
content.description: Apply knowledge of computing fundamentals, computing specialisation, mathematics, and domain knowledge appropriate for the computing specialisation to the abstraction and conceptualisation of computing models from defined problems and requirements.

content.title: Problem Analysis
content.description: Identify, formulate, research literature, and solve complex computing problems reaching substantiated conclusions using fundamental principles of mathematics, computing sciences, and relevant domain disciplines.

content.title: Design/development of solutions
content.description: Design and evaluate solutions for complex computing problems, and design and evaluate systems, components, or processes that meet specified needs with appropriate consideration for public health and safety, cultural, societal, and environmental considerations.

content.title: Conduct investigations of complex problems
content.description: Use research-based knowledge and research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.

content.title: Modern tool usage
content.description: Create, select, adapt and apply appropriate techniques, resources, and modern computing tools to complex computing activities, with an understanding of the limitations.

content.title: Professional Ethics
content.description: Understand and commit to professional ethics and cyber regulations, responsibilities, and norms of professional computing practices.

content.title: Life-long Learning
content.description: Recognize the need, and have the ability, to engage in independent learning for continual development as a computing professional.

content.title: Project Management and Finance
content.description: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of t h e c o m p u t i n g and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.

content.title: Communication Efficacy
content.description: Communicate effectively with the computing community, and with society at large, about complex computing activities by being able to comprehend and write effective reports, design documentation, make effective presentations, and give and understand clear instructions.

content.title: Societal and Environmental Concern
content.description: Understand and assess societal, environmental, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues within local and global contexts, and the consequential responsibilities relevant to professional computing practices.

content.title: Individual and Team Work
content.description: Function effectively as an individual and as a member or leader in diverse teams and in multidisciplinary environments.

content.title: Innovation and Entrepreneurship
content.description: Identify a timely opportunity and using innovation to pursue that opportunity to create value and wealth for the betterment of the individual and society at large.
Ability to understand and apply knowledge on mathematics, analysis, design and development of software applications.
Ability to work with latest computing technologies and pursue career goals in IT industry / pursue higher studies.

content.title: Dr. Shanthi P, M.C.A., M.Phil., Ph.D.,
content.subTi: Head of the Department – Master of Computer Applications(M.C.A.)

text: Dr. Shanthi P, M.C.A., M.Phil., Ph.D., Professor & Head, School of  Computer Applications, has 20+ years of teaching experience, including 3+ years in departmental leadership. Her technical expertise includes Natural Language Processing, Ontology-based systems, Machine Learning, Data Analytics, and Deep Learning with a proven track record in research, grants, and institutional coordination.

She has published 17 Scopus-indexed papers, 2 Web of Science papers, and 15 conference papers. She has authored 5+ book chapters and a textbook on System Software for the Anna University Syllabus. She holds 3 Indian Patents. She has guided numerous industrial and technical PG projects.

She received Grants & Projects from AICTE with ₹2,90,000 for a two-week FDP on Deep Learning and Computational Intelligence in Bioinformatics. She has also got a sponsor from DRDO worth ₹25,000 for organizing workshop on Data Mining and Semantic Web. She is a recipient of Best Faculty Award and achieved Infosys Inspire Faculty Partnership (Bronze Level), and Overall ERP Coordinator Award, during her academic tenure.

She has organized 50+ department events like seminars, workshops, many technical and non technical events. One of the non-technical events are recorded in India book of records during 2023 for preparing 15,618 paper bags on Paper bag day. She has also attended numerous programs on Cyber Security, Cloud Computing, Big Data, and AI/ML at institutions. She has guided numerous industrial and technical PG projects. She also acted an academic mentor for Smart India Hackathon for three years. She is a life member of ISTE.

The Department of MCA at KCE is led by proficient faculty specializing in advanced computing applications. With a focus on research, innovation, and practical learning, they prepare students for successful careers in the software and IT industry.
